title: The Cats Are Waking Up
staging:
Scene 08 — The Cats Are Waking Up

06:50–07:30 · 40 sec · District 7 alleyways

Excited cats leave the rally, spreading the news throughout the neighborhood. Resistance graffiti appears on walls. A young kitten asks whether the crew can actually fix the shortage.

Shots: Forward tracking through cheering crowd → banners → kitten looking up → Trixie's thoughtful expression.
